translations.web: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord Yahweh, the God of Armies.
translations.bsb: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob, declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts.
translations.kjv: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,
